risk_if_not_implemented: Without Comprehensive Asset Inventory Management, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be unknown, untracked, lost, stolen or left unprotected because they are not inventoried. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Asset Inventories
compensating_control_1.justification: Asset Inventories (AST-04) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Comprehensive Asset Inventory Management (AST-08) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Asset Discovery
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to perform asset discovery to identify Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) connected to organizational networks, including assets not present in existing inventories.
compensating_control_2.justification: Asset Discovery (AST-09) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Comprehensive Asset Inventory Management (AST-08) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
